identitySignals: The Bay Area Collaborative (BAC) is a group of member SELPA (Special Education Local Planning Area) directors that sets an annual master contract and rates for nonpublic special education schools and agencies (Solano County SELPA page), matching OUSD's 'Special education' purpose and 'Fee Agreement' title.
No page found that lists Oakland Unified or Alameda County as a member, so the OUSD link is not independently confirmed.
research.notes: Appears to be an informal inter-SELPA contracting body hosted on the Solano County SELPA website, not a registered entity with its own website, EIN or CA entity number. Contact details on that page belong to the chairperson/Solano County SELPA, so they were omitted. OUSD membership not confirmed. Not suitable for publication.

profile.summary: The Bay Area Collaborative is a group of Special Education Local Planning Area (SELPA) directors, with nonpublic agency and nonpublic school representatives. It develops an annual master contract and negotiates rates for preferred nonpublic schools and agencies that provide special education services.
